findings.address_as_written: Jackson Playground Field House, Mariposa and Arkansas Streets
findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission ratified a $12,750 architectural services agreement with Delp W. Johnson, Poole and Storm, architects, to design a new field house at Jackson Playground, Mariposa and Arkansas Streets.

findings.address_as_written: A Plan for the San Francisco Zoo
findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission adopted in principle "A Plan for the San Francisco Zoo" by Esherick, Hornsey, Dodge and Davis, architects and planners, covering land use, landscaping, the collections, buildings and circulation, subject to environmental review of each project; Joseph Esherick had presented the preliminary plan in March.
